title: Intropy port binding kinds
description: The closed set of Dapr binding kinds a port can deploy as or resolve to locally. Two template catalogs draw from this one enum: deploy-host's spec.gitops.bindingKinds (GitOps adapter files) and deploy-component's spec.local.fixtures (local development fixtures). This document is the single owner so the two catalogs cannot drift.
$comment: Names are the catalog spelling, not the Dapr component type: 'file' deploys as bindings.localstorage — there is no bindings.file. Adding a kind requires a fixture server in the k3s setup scripts and an adapter skeleton in deploy-host; it is a template-library change, not a CLI release. Removing a kind is breaking.
